gap: The invoicing page never shows an invoice. Both product visuals are the SAME generic dashboard mockup (sidebar + $24,180 +18% + bar chart), mirrored left/right in the 'One invoicing tool for every market' and 'Invoicing inside a full ERP' sections. Replace both with two DIFFERENT, specific invoicing screens rendered at real UI fidelity: (1) the invoice composer with line items, a currency selector showing OMR/AED/USD and a VAT line computing on the net, and (2) an invoice list with real invoice numbers, client names, due dates and Paid/Overdue/Sent status pills, plus the pay-online link. Wave's fold leads with its actual invoice builder and template picker; ours leads with type only and then shows an abstract chart twice, which reads as placeholder art and is the one thing undercutting the trust the rest of the page earns.
